def up_seq(a):

rows=B62.split("\n"); cols=list(rows[0].strip()); MM={}
for r_ in rows[1:]:
    aa=r_[0]
    for c,v in zip(cols,[int(x) for x in re.findall(r'-?\d+',r_[1:])]): MM[(aa,c)]=v
def sc(a,b): return MM.get((a,b),MM.get((b,a),-1))
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(s1),len(s2); NEG=-10**7
    Mx=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float); Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float); Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG,float)
    Tm=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8); Ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    Mx[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); Tx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); Ty[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        a=s1[i-1]; mp=Mx[i-1]; xp=Ix[i-1]; yp=Iy[i-1]
        srow=np.array([sc(a,b) for b in s2],float)
        diag=np.vstack([mp[:-1],xp[:-1],yp[:-1]]); Mx[i,1:]=diag.max(0)+srow; Tm[i,1:]=diag.argmax(0)
        up=np.vstack([mp[1:]+go,xp[1:]+ge]); Ix[i,1:]=up.max(0); Tx[i,1:]=up.argmax(0)
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            c0=Mx[i,j-1]+go; c1=Iy[i,j-1]+ge
            if c0>=c1: Iy[i,j]=c0; Ty[i,j]=0
            else: Iy[i,j]=c1; Ty[i,j]=1
    i,j=n,m; st=int(np.argmax((Mx[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]))); A1=[];A2=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if st==0: A1.append(s1[i-1]); A2.append(s2[j-1]); st=Tm[i,j]; i-=1; j-=1
        elif st==1: A1.append(s1[i-1]); A2.append("-"); st=Tx[i,j]; i-=1
        else: A1.append("-"); A2.append(s2[j-1]); st=Ty[i,j]; j-=1
        if i==0 and j>0: st=2
        if j==0 and i>0: st=1
    return "".join(reversed(A1)),"".join(reversed(A2))
def mapper(ref,tgt):
    a,b=nw(ref,tgt); ri=ti=0; mp={}
    for x,y in zip(a,b):
        if x!="-": ri+=1
        if y!="-": ti+=1
        if x!="-" and y!="-": mp[ri]=(ti,y)
    al=[(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b) if x!="-" and y!="-"]
    return mp,100*sum(x==y for x,y in al)/len(al)
